name: 3x1 spinful Fermi-Hubbard JW spectrum
task_prompt: Create a 3 by 1 spinful Fermi-Hubbard Hamiltonian with tunneling=0.9, onsite interaction=1.5, zero chemical potential, and periodic=False using OpenFermion. Jordan-Wigner transform it, construct the sparse matrix with an explicit qubit count, compute the lowest eigenvalue and normalized ground state, and verify the energy by direct expectation. Also construct total particle number, print its expectation and variance, and assert Hermiticity and a near-zero eigenpair residual. Provide only complete executable Python code. Do not use remote services. Seed random generators, print the requested quantities, and include robust self-tests rather than relying on visual inspection.
